<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/delivery.ts -->
<!--
  How delivery works: the facts as icon cards, then the zones with their time and the order that ships free.
  Axes: layout (full: facts over zone cards, facts: the facts only, split: the facts beside a list of zones),
  tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { DeliveryLabels } from "./delivery-info.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
import type { Zone } from "./zone-table.types";

export type DeliveryInfoProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  facts: Feature[];
  zones: Zone[];
  labels: DeliveryLabels;
  layout?: "full" | "facts" | "split";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  facts,
  zones,
  labels,
  layout = "full",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<DeliveryInfoProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Box
      :class="cn(
        'grid grid-cols-1 gap-8',
        (((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'items-start md:grid-cols-2' : '')
      )"
    >
      <Grid :cols="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? '1-2' : '1-4')" class="gap-4" data-testid="facts">
        <Stack
          v-for="f in facts"
          :key="f.id"
          gap="4"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
          data-testid="fact"
        >
          <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
            <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="20" />
          </Box>
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ f.title }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ f.text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
      <Stack v-if="((layout as string) !== 'facts')" gap="4" align="stretch">
        <Title :as="3" size="lg" weight="bold">
          {{ labels.zones }}
        </Title>
        <Box
          :class="
            (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'flex flex-col gap-4'
            : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3'
          "
        >
          <Stack v-for="z in zones" :key="z.id"
            gap="2"
            :class="
              (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'border-b border-border pb-4'
              : 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6'
            "
            data-testid="zone"
          >
            <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {{ z.name }}
              </Text>
              <Badge variant="secondary" size="default">
                {{ z.time }}
              </Badge>
            </Group>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ z.area }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" weight="medium">
              {{ tpl(labels.freeFrom, fmtMoney(z.freeFrom, z.currency)) }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
